verdict.rationale: Qdrant's docs describe a distributed deployment mode in which multiple Qdrant peers distribute data to extend storage and increase stability. Qdrant Private Cloud manages database clusters on any Kubernetes infrastructure, the GitHub material names sharding as a tuning decision, and community users report it scales well in production. Missing for 10: detailed sharding/replication configuration docs (shard counts, replication factor, resharding or rebalancing) and independent hands-on corroboration of multi-node cluster operation.
